title: DogTag RedactedTagArtifact v1
description: Selective disclosure by obfuscation over a device-built profile tree (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 15). NOT a W3C VC credential and NOT one of the five record-type schemas beside this file: a RedactedTagArtifact is a TagArtifact-shaped custody/export wire record, so it does not compose dogtag.envelope.v1 and carries no recordType/credentialSubject. Shape only - this schema says nothing about whether `root` actually recomputes from `disclosed`+`obfuscatedLeafHashes`+`reservedLeafHashes`; that is verifyRedactedArtifact's job (packages/dogtag-standard-ts/src/redactedArtifact.ts, crates/dogtag-standard-rs/src/redacted_artifact.rs), a leaf-commitment-layer check this registry layer does not and cannot perform (specs/schemas/README.md - shape and encoding are independent axes).

protocolVersion.description: e.g. "dogtag-v2/1" (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 12) - which fixed encoding-and-hashing manner this artifact's leaves were committed under.

schemaId.description: Optional: the registry $id of the record type this credential was issued/received against (e.g. one of this directory's five VC record-type $id values). Absent on a legacy/backfilled artifact whose original bind session predates schemaId stamping - the leaf-commitment root recompute never depends on it.

dogTagIdDec.description: Optional: the issuing clinic's own off-chain decimal handle, for display only. Absent for many imported artifacts.

dogTagIdField.description: The canonical on-chain dogTagId field (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 11's dogTagIdField), as a decimal string - the profileRoot(dogTagIdField) == root binding key. OUTSIDE the leaf-commitment tree entirely: never a leaf, never subject to obfuscatedLeafHashes/disclosed.

root.description: The profile tree's Merkle root R (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 7).

disclosed.description: Fully opened attribute leaves - the OpenedLeaf shape (packages/dogtag-standard-ts/src/profileBind.ts). A full, unredacted artifact is the degenerate case where this array holds every attribute leaf and obfuscatedLeafHashes is empty.

obfuscatedLeafHashes.description: Attribute leaves named ONLY by their opaque hash - masked BY CHOICE (the discloser held the opening and withheld it). Disjoint in principle from disclosed and reservedLeafHashes; verifyRedactedArtifact rejects any overlap at the leaf-commitment layer.

reservedLeafHashes.description: The three owner-control leaves (owner.address, owner.consentKey, owner.secret - specs/leaf-commitment.md section 9), always opaque BY CONSTRUCTION. Exactly 3 on every conformant artifact, full or redacted alike; never openable through this or any other wire format.

issuerClone.description: The 0x.. issuer clone address this root was (or is claimed to have been) issued against.

hex32.description: A 32-byte big-endian field element, 0x-prefixed lowercase-or-uppercase hex (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 5). Shape only: a value in this exact pattern can still exceed the BN254 scalar field modulus, which only the leaf-commitment-layer parser (fromHex32/from_hex32) rejects.

decimalString.description: A canonical non-negative decimal-digit string (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 2's Integer grammar, restricted to non-negative here - no dogTagId handle or field element is ever negative in practice): no leading zeros.

openedLeaf.description: keyPath/saltHex/tag/value - the packed wire form specs/leaf-commitment.md section 4 describes, split into named fields.

saltHex.description: 16 raw bytes, hex-encoded. The 0x prefix is optional here (hexToBytes/hex::decode strip it when present) - this schema is deliberately no stricter than the code it mirrors.

tag.description: TypeTag (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 1's table): 0 Null, 1 Bool, 2 String, 3 Integer, 4 Decimal, 5 Bytes.

value.description: The packed wire value (section 4): the canonical string form for every tag except Bytes, whose value is lowercase hex with no 0x prefix; Null's value is the empty string.
